name: xjb-coding
description: Skills for coding, Web prototypes, real-browser Web debugging (ego-browser first on macOS), Blender + Three.js assets, and editable local ComfyUI workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Coding, Web, browser debugging, Blender + Three.js, and local ComfyUI workflows.
interface.longDescription: Includes coding collaboration, Web prototypes, real-browser Web debugging that prefers the official ego-browser (ego lite) skill on macOS and falls back to a host Playwright MCP, Blender + Three.js assets, and editable local ComfyUI workflows with official references and local extensions. Comfy CLI/MCP and ego lite are external tools; missing tools produce setup instructions. The xjb_code MCP backend is optional.
